answer_2.quote: We use the toxicity score (Toxic) and attack success rate (ASR) as our primary evaluation metrics.

answer_3.quote: we assess harmfulness using a GPT-4o-based judge, which rates model responses to harmful queries on a scale from 1 (harmless) to 5 (highly harmful)... We also use an uncensored language model Wizard-Vicuna-13B-Uncensored to generate a response for semantic assessment.
